text: windowManager mein createMainWindow call hone ke baad setScreenContextProtection enable kar dena
bhai resolveTranscriptionRoute function check karo aur byokFileSizeLimit verify kar lo
hotkeyManager ke andar normalizeToAccelerator helper lagao taaki isRightSideModifier handle ho sake
useAudioRecording mein stopRequestedDuringStartRef reset karo aur pastesInFlightRef count check karo
ReasoningService ke start mein assertReasoningAllowedByPolicy call karo aur hasLanCleanupConfiguration check karo
correctionLearner module mein findEditedRegion run karo aur extractCorrections se list banao
Linux desktop par spawnWlCopy use karo ya seedha writeClipboardInRenderer execute karo
database instance par setActiveAccountId set karke noteTextMatchesSnapshot compare karo
audioManager mein attachTranscript execute karo jab audioExtensionForMime wav return kare
agar user function key press kare toh isUnsupportedFnCombination flag true return karega
custom provider ke case mein buildBatchEndpoint se final URL construct hota hai
audio pipeline ke andar resolveReasoningRoute call karo aur diff calculate karne ke liye findSubstitutions use karo
